Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Previewed for Nintendo Switch 2

A hands-on preview of a remake of the 1998 game "The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time" for the Nintendo Switch 2 has been released. The preview highlights a prettified kingdom of Hyrule, a newly orchestrated soundtrack, and a different feel for the main character. An overview trailer for the remake has also been released, with one outlet describing it as looking incredible.
